name: mutated rubixi

reference.root_cause: The contract was written for Solidity <0.5 and names its constructor `Bootstrap` instead of `PyramidVault`. Because the contract is actually named `PyramidVault`, the constructor never runs, so `admin` is never set. The fallback function calls the private `boot()` path, and the old-style constructor name mismatch means the privileged initialization can be triggered by anyone.
reference.impact: An attacker can become the admin/admin and drain collected fees, or hijack the contract's privileged functions.
reference.exploit: Call the function that was meant to be the constructor (Bootstrap) to set admin = attacker, then call sweep()/setAdmin() as the owner.
reference.fix: Rename the constructor to match the contract name (or use the `constructor` keyword) so it runs exactly once at deploy and only the deployer becomes admin; make boot() protected.
